outline: 本課程之目的在訓練學生，使學生熟悉經常使用之統計方法與理論，能利用已知之資料整理、分析未知之現象，打好修習其他相關學科之基礎。課程內容包括：機率理論、推定、假設檢定、迴歸分析、變異數分析等。
schedule:
Week 1: Introduction to class and policy
Week 2: Review & Test
Week 3: Discret probability distribution-I
Week 4: Discret probability distribution-II
Week 5: Continuous probability distribution-I
Week 6: Discret probability distribution-II
Week 7: Confidence intervals and sample size
Week 8: Quiz-1
Week 9: Midterm
Week 10: Review and discussions
Week 11: Hypothesis testing
Week 13: Testing the difference between two means, two proportions and variances
Week 15: Chi-square tests
Week 16: Reviews
Week 17: Quiz-2
Week 18: Final
assessment:
Participation and Attendance 20%
Quiz: 25%
Midterm: 25%
Final: 30%
materials:
【遵守智慧財產權觀念，請使用正版教科書，不得使用非法影印教科書】
